171:t_1:90.en:
$$ラクス$$
「$$キラ$$... Do you know the person called the first $$コーディネイター$$?」

171:t_1:91.en:
$$キラ$$
「Do you mean 《$$ジョージ・グレン$$》?」

171:t_1:92.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Yes. ...Then do you know why $$コーディネイター$$s were created?」

171:t_1:93.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ジョージ・グレン$$ said... it was to act as coordinators, bridging humanity and the new humanity that would someday emerge.」

171:t_1:94.en:
$$ラクス$$
「He may have believed that himself.」

171:t_1:95.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But the truth was entirely different.」

171:t_1:97.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Do you know what he meant by 'new humanity' in the first place?」

171:t_1:98.en:
$$キラ$$
「...Is it something like $$宇宙世紀$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$イノベイター$$s?」

171:t_1:99.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Their existence has largely been proven. But no such humans have been confirmed in our world... the $$コズミック・イラ$$.」

171:t_1:100.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Apparently there are theories, but research into them has all but stopped.」

171:t_1:101.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Why do you think that is?」

171:t_1:102.en:
$$キラ$$
「Even if you ask me, I don't know...」

171:t_1:103.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Perhaps such people had already been confirmed somewhere we knew nothing about...」

171:t_1:105.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Their existence was probably erased in secret...」

171:t_1:106.en:
$$ラクス$$
「By the $$クロノ$$ of our world.」

171:t_1:108.en:
$$ラクス$$
「What $$クロノ$$ fears is a new humanity being born in space.」

171:t_1:109.en:
$$ラクス$$
「That is why they used 《$$ロゴス$$》 and its subordinate organization, 《$$ブルーコスモス$$》, to attack $$コーディネイター$$s in our world.」

171:t_1:110.en:
$$キラ$$
「Wait, $$ラクス$$...! Are you saying $$コーディネイター$$s are that new humanity?!」

171:t_1:111.en:
$$キラ$$
「Weren't $$コーディネイター$$s meant to link that new humanity with humanity?!」

171:t_1:112.en:
$$ラクス$$
「...$$コーディネイター$$s were born from a project to artificially create a new humanity...」

171:t_1:113.en:
$$ラクス$$
「At the same time, they exist to protect the new humanity that will someday emerge, shielding it from $$クロノ$$.」

171:t_1:115.en:
$$ラクス$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s... were created by the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who split off from $$クロノ$$.」

171:t_1:116.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ラクス$$...! What are you saying?!」

171:t_1:119.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I wanted to unite the people called the $$クライン派$$ to change the tide drawing $$プラント$$ toward war.」

171:t_1:120.en:
$$ラクス$$
「In the process, I found a written account my father had left for me.」

171:t_1:121.en:
$$キラ$$
「Do you mean your father... Chairman $$シーゲル・クライン$$...?」

171:t_1:122.en:
$$ラクス$$
「It contained everything I just told you.」

171:t_1:123.en:
$$ラクス$$
「And I learned... that my family, the $$クライン$$s, belongs to the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

171:t_1:125.en:
$$ラクス$$
「The key people involved in founding $$プラント$$ were probably under the influence of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

171:t_1:126.en:
$$ラクス$$
「That truth also explains why some saw the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives... or the $$ナチュラル$$s living on Earth, as potential enemies.」

171:t_1:127.en:
$$キラ$$
「The war between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s stems from a split within $$クロノ$$...」

171:t_1:128.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Amid that, my father and the others in the $$クライン派$$ sought a peaceful solution...」

171:t_1:129.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But now, with the mood turning toward war, even the $$クライン派$$ has returned to its original ideals and resolved to fight the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

171:t_1:130.en:
$$ラクス$$
「They have joined others who learned the truth about the past, and are trying to lead $$プラント$$ into war.」

171:t_1:131.en:
$$キラ$$
「So these hidden truths have only now been revealed to so many people...?」

171:t_1:132.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I don't know how that came about...」

171:t_1:133.en:
$$キラ$$
「But $$クロノ$$ lost its power in the $$時獄戦役$$...! And with $$サイデリアル$$ here, for Earthlings to fight each other...!」

171:t_1:134.en:
$$ラクス$$
「They probably intend to follow $$フル・フロンタル$$'s words and declare themselves the rightful successors of Earth's humanity.」

171:t_1:135.en:
$$ラクス$$
「By overthrowing the $$地球連邦$$... the $$ナチュラル$$s...」

171:t_1:136.en:
$n
「$$キラ$$! Armed people are gathering around the council building!」

171:t_1:137.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's get out of here, $$ラクス$$!」

171:t_1:140.en:
$$ラクス$$
「As a $$クライン$$... there is something I must do...」

171:t_1:141.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「$$ラクス$$, we've come to escort you.」

171:t_1:145.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「I see... You were meeting him here to bring him over to our fighting forces, $$ラクス$$.」

171:t_1:149.en:
$$ラクス$$
「With my wishes in your heart.」

171:t_1:151.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$...! You, too, will fulfill your mission as a $$コーディネイター$$!」

171:t_1:152.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「Your power as an $$スーパーコーディネイター$$ is precisely what we need to fight the $$ナチュラル$$s.」

171:t_1:157.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「Come with us, $$キラ・ヤマト$$.」

171:t_1:161.en:
$$シン$$
「$n! I'm counting on you to take care of $$キラ$$!」

171:t_1:163.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「As the symbol of $$コーディネイター$$s, $$キラ・ヤマト$$ must become our power to annihilate the $$ナチュラル$$s!」

171:t_1:164.en:
$$ザフト兵$$
「The people of space will become the true Earthlings, the new humanity to lead the next age!」

171:t_1:167.en:
$$アスラン$$
「At this rate, $$プラント$$ will... head straight for destruction!」
